Work Q&A: besides venting, you can ask a question. Switch to Answers to see only questions — three a day, and rejected ones don\'t count.
Industry filter: tap the industry button to select several at once and see only the fields you care about.
Today\'s Voices: swipe cards to send ❤️ 💪 😢.
Answerer badges: an approved comment earns 10 EXP, one marked helpful earns 100, across five tiers. The person who asked marks which reply actually helped.
My Corner: manage your own posts and comments; changing your industry or nickname can update past posts too.
Earn coins: +1 per daily stamp, +5 per approved post.

resources.string: Although 77 has logged out of this world,\nthe code he left behind is still running.
Thank you\nfor laying an important foundation for the Android version of QuitCard,\nhelping more people find the courage to face work through this app.
May you be free from pain and worry in the other world, with nothing but freedom and joy.
This time, it\'s your turn to rest well.
